goal: Prepare the exact pretrained Gemma source as a personality-specific frozen representation provider without substituting publisher preferences for personal judgment.
procedure: Verify original source contracts after context-index navigation; preserve obsolete custom-N0 research for v2; bind an unchanged personality-role clone to a frozen token-feature interface, implementation hashes, explicit input/output contracts and exact runtime; prohibit publisher generation and gradients; run public complete-input diagnostics in a fresh owner-scoped Slurm stage; retain unqualified state until independent semantic and causal judgment gates pass.
constraints: No MFM specialist, corpus or objective reuse
No private identity payload in public artifacts
Do not mutate existing compute workstreams
Use the owner's account and existing scientific container
decision_criteria: Exact pretrained publisher pin and all eight file hashes
Finite detached token-aligned features and complete masks
Relevant and irrelevant interventions evaluated separately
Receipt or fixture success cannot establish personality competence
authority: Implement reversible first-party preparation and use authorized owner compute for public diagnostics; no declaration of N0, learned personality, FloRA or builder-transfer approval.
validation: Independent source/context and operating-rule review plus custody/interface/diagnostic fixture tests; actual publisher hashing and forward outcomes must be linked separately when completed.
failure_or_lesson: A shared publisher checkpoint is ancestry, not a shared model role. Removing the publisher language head suppresses a direct preference path but does not prove hidden states are neutral. Historical runtime success and stale context indexes cannot admit a new personality artifact.
